thread:
kai: Heads up — the new JS SDK 1.2.0 shipped but our sample-app in the onboarding flow fails with `Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'` when run with Node 16.

anya: That's bad. Does `npm pack` show the artifacts?

kai: Pasted output from the published tarball: 
```
package/README.md
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/package.json
```
No `dist/node` and no `types`.

pkg-bot: publish job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/2244 — packaging step used `files: ["dist/**", "README.md"]` in package.json. Looks like `dist/types` is generated to `dist/_types` by our dts script so it was ignored.

ops: Oh no — our `dts` postbuild moves `*.d.ts` into `_types/` for historic reasons. npm `files` doesn't include `_types`. That explains missing types.

anya: Also saw source maps referencing `index.cjs.map` in the Sentry stacktrace even though only `.mjs` present. Mix-up between bundler configs.

kai: The onboarding sample-app uses `require()` in the quickstart for simplicity, which triggers the node path. Edge (Vercel) preview worked because it loads ESM. So half our users are blocked.

david: And support is getting tickets complaining about failing type imports in TypeScript editors — missing `.d.ts` so intellisense is broken.

pkg-bot: Quick mitigation: we can republish 1.2.1 that includes `dist/node/index.cjs` (build with `tsup` formats `cjs,esm`) and move types to `dist/types/index.d.ts`. I can trigger a hotfix publish if someone approves.

ops: Approve. Also we should fix the `files` entry to include `_types` or better yet change dts output to `dist/types`.

anya: Suggest adding a pre-publish smoke test in CI: `npm pack` + `tar -tf` and then run Node/Require + ESM import + TypeScript `tsc --noEmit` against the tarball.

kai: Agreed. Another follow-up: check `exports` field. Right now package.json has `"require": "dist/index.cjs"` and `"import": "dist/index.mjs"` but since we only shipped ESM the require path lied. We should make `exports` target `dist/node/index.cjs` and `dist/edge/index.mjs`.

david: Slight tangent — I noticed the SDK retry logic is re-trying on 401 in the browser build but not in node. That caused our onboarding to loop the auth flow for a bit before failing. Might be a separate packaging issue (different retry predicate between bundles).

anya: Hmm that could be because our auth wrapper uses a different build flag in the edge bundle. Let's add a test that hits the auth endpoint and asserts no retries on 401.

ops: Filed an issue: https://go.redwood.com/issue/SDK-224-auth-retry-mismatch. Assigning to @david.

david: I'll take it. For the publishing problem: doing a local recreate now. Running `npm pack` locally to verify.

pkg-bot: Local `npm pack` for 1.2.1-rc: 
```
package/dist/node/index.cjs
package/dist/node/index.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/dist/types/index.d.ts
package/package.json
```
Smoke tests: node require/import ✅, ESM import on Vercel preview ✅, tsc typecheck ✅.

kai: Awesome. When you publish stable, please update the quickstart docs to prefer `import` but include a `require()` snippet for Node users, and mention the supported runtimes.

anya: Also adding a release checklist item: "verify artifacts (cjs, mjs, d.ts) + exports mapping + CI smoke tests".

ops: I'll open PR to change dts output path and CI pack-check.

david: Republished 1.2.1 stable. Support notified, changelog updated.

kai: Thanks team. Small ask: can we add a lint or unit that ensures we don't accidentally change publish layout in the future? Maybe a tiny script that compares `package.json` `files` vs actual dist contents.

anya: Good idea. I'll prototype that script and add to the build pipeline.

pkg-bot: Closing hotfix thread once CI merges.
